entities.name: Oligoribonuclease A1TND9
observations: The query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A1TND9 from Paracidovorax citrulli; the reference annotates a cytoplasmic 3′-to-5′ exoribonuclease acting on small oligoribonucleotides.
Query sequence contains Pfam RNase_T domain PF00929 at residues 21–183 (i-Evalue 9.3e-36).
